title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode6 Making a Connection

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What brings you all here? I thought we had individual practice tonight...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Rui and I were both practicing at home, but then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu contacted me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She did?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today, when I saw you talking with Asahi, you looked all scrunched up somehow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I thought, “That has to mean Tsukasa feels like he has to work super hard for this.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I talked about it with Nene on the phone, and she said she and Rui had been talking about the same exact thing on their way back home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We wondered if there might be anything we could do to help you. And just as we met up to discuss...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It turned out a certain someone had gotten here first.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly... You all never fail to read me like a book.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, we have known each other for a pretty long time at this point.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll do anything I have to!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-That's a big promise to make...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, “anything” is a pretty strong word...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But if you need a sounding board, just tell me. You always do it for me, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. Though, we may be letting our selfish hopes get in your way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you want to see this through with only your own strength to rely on, then we have full faith in you to do so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We just want you to remember. You can ask anything of us, and we will do it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After all, we want to see your dream come true just as much as we each want to see our own!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can only watch as Asahi continues along the path ahead of me.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My imagination, my range of expression... None of it holds a candle to him.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I have them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In that case, perhaps you can help me. This may take some time to go over. Is that alright?

rows.Speaker: Rui, Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So you were troubled by the despair scene at the climax, as I thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a tricky thing. I can't really picture it very well myself, either...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmmm...! Despair... Despair, huh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-What's wrong, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I tried imagining what it'd be like if Phoenix Wonderland closed down, and it made me so sad...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right... It's very precious to you, after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't push yourself too hard, Emu. This is a pretty unpleasant exercise.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may be difficult to bear... But “losing something precious to you” might be a worthwhile angle to approach this from.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The problem is, as I said, what's most precious to me is my dream...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I can't picture myself losing it... I'm just going in circles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wonder how Asahi did it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good question. Maybe if we asked him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I doubt Asahi's understanding of despair would be of much help to us.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's experienced an actual conflict, after all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... Right. You're right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's talked about it before. His family was caught up in a conflict, and he was separated from his parents...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (When I think about it that way, perhaps Prince Blesse and Asahi are similar.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Though touched by despair, they still wish to see peace and smiles on people's faces...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What is it, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, just... I feel close to making a connection...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“No matter what I do, humanity will still hate.
Countries will still wage war.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “The conflict ignited by last week's military invasion has had a severe impact on the region.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Everyday life ends just like that, and smiles and laughter vanish...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This might work...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? Did you figure something out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks to you all, I've found the clue I needed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've found my despair. And how to picture it.
Six weeks later
Center Theatre

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Let's see, Wonderlands×Showtime should be sitting over...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Ah, there you are!
Hey, you guys!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Asahi! I'm very much looking forward to today.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! Let's all give it everything we've got!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Although... I didn't expect you guys to end up performing last.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me neither. It was a shock when I saw the lot I'd drawn.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you'll be up just before us, as well.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah. Haha, it feels like fate, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: There are some pretty big names here today. Going last is a lot of pressure, but...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Actually, never mind. I can see the confidence in you all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thanks to my friends, I've come to understand what despair means to me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So... I feel confident I can give my best performance yet.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I see! I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: <Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats. The show will begin momentarily.>

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, sounds like it's starting.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I'm glad we got a chance to talk! See you after everything!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Your best performance yet, eh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now you've gone and said it, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? So what if I have?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe♪ I love seeing Tsukasa all sharp and sparkly bright!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But of course! I am Tsukasa Tenma, future star, after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (My dream is to become a star who can make everyone smile with my shows...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Having spent so long chasing that dream... It made preparing for this role all the more distressing.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've read books, watched footage, listened to talks... I've given myself nightmares from all the things I've imagined.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However... That's exactly why I can say it for sure.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That I am going to give the greatest performance I can.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I will embody it...
The “despair” that I have found!)
